every_tunnel.ch2.l1.follow_01: Finish up and follow me. Don't ask questions out here.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.follow_03: Keep up. Don't look at the cameras.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_01: Close the door. This is the only room without cameras. The law protects it, so they can't touch it.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_02: You swept the west corridor. You saw the glass.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_03: I-I don't like this. T-too many p-people in one r-room.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_04: T-t-too many p-p-people! Ha ha ha ha!
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_05: Enough. Both of you. One is shaking like a leaf and the other is laughing like a clogged drain. This is a secret meeting, not a circus.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_06: That's the man who had your desk.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_07: Management says he's on sick leave. He has been behind that glass for four days.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_08: And they rebuilt everything around it. New paint, new rules. "All previous documentation archived."
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_09: Rowan came back four months ago. Supervisor. More pay than he ever had as an engineer. Nobody asks why.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_10: People get "reassigned". We don't see them again.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_11: We need proof. Something with his name on it, something a labor inspector can't ignore.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_12: The auxiliary lab keeps the containment records. Take this. It's a copy of a lab badge. It opens one door.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_13: Rowan signs everything with a personal code. Find a document that has it.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_14: The guards won't hurt you. They'll walk you out and write your name down. That's all we're afraid of.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.meeting_15: Don't talk to me again. We were never here.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_loyal_a1: Good morning, my friends. Another day closer to what we deserve.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_loyal_a2: Don't be shy. Hard work is rewarded here. Eventually.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_loyal_a3: Some of you are tired. That's natural. Rest is for people without a future.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_loyal_a4: Remember: those who stay with me, stay ahead. Those who don't... well. Time is rarely kind.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_loyal_a5: I'm proud of you. All of you.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_office_c1: Find anything interesting in my desk? Or are you just admiring the view?
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_office_c2: Look at you. Hands shaking, eyes everywhere. Did you think I wouldn't notice?
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_office_c3: Tell me, do you always wander into offices that aren't yours? Or am I special?
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_office_c4: Curious. Nobody comes here by accident. Not even the ones too stupid to be afraid.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_office_c5: Who told you this door would be open?
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_office_c6: No answer. Fine. I'll find out eventually. I always do.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_office_c7: Go. Back to your post. You're lucky I'm in a good mood today.
every_tunnel.ch2.l1.rowan_office_c8: Oh, and since you clearly have energy to spare, you'll stay three extra hours tonight. Unpaid, naturally. Think of it as an investment.
